sgem.subtitle: Choose a package and a payment method.
sgem.discountTip: Want a better deal? Talk to Sai for exclusive discounts.

checkout.title: Bank Transfer Payment
checkout.subtitle: Scan the QR or transfer manually to complete payment.
checkout.redirectDesc: Click the button below if you are not redirected automatically.
checkout.warning: Enter the transfer note exactly as shown. Payments are matched by this code — if it is wrong, your payment will not be detected automatically.
checkout.successDesc: {amount} sGem has been added to your wallet.
checkout.failedDesc: The payment could not be processed. Please try again.
checkout.expiredDesc: This payment has expired. Please create a new one.
checkout.credit_failedDesc: We received your payment but could not credit your sGem yet. Please contact an admin.

directTransfer.title: Direct Transfer
directTransfer.subtitle: Transfer the exact amount to our account, then submit the form below.
directTransfer.notePlaceholder: Include your transfer reference number, bank name, or any other info to help us verify faster.
directTransfer.confirmLabel: I understand this is a manual bank transfer and I am ready to proceed.
directTransfer.transferredLabel: I have successfully transferred the money.
directTransfer.submitSuccess: Submitted! Our team will verify your transfer shortly.
directTransfer.submitSuccessDesc: You will receive a notification once the transfer is verified.
directTransfer.qrHint: Scan with MoMo or any banking app that supports VietQR.

steamLink.failed: Could not load the linked Steam account. Try again.
steamLink.notLinked: No Steam account is linked. You can only link it in the Steam game.

twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, then enter the code from the app.
twoFactor.manualKey: Or enter this setup key manually:
twoFactor.setupExpiry: Setup expires after 10 minutes. Keep the QR code and setup key private.
twoFactor.studioLocked: You can turn off 2FA only when you no longer own or belong to any studio.
twoFactor.disableSupportNote: If you have to turn it off, pls talk to
twoFactor.changed: Your 2FA setting has changed. Sign in again to continue. If you just enabled it, wait for the next code before signing in.
twoFactor.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait 5 minutes before trying again.
twoFactor.stateChanged: The setup has expired or changed. Start setup again.
twoFactor.recoverySaveHelp: These 10 codes are shown only once. Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe, separate from your phone. Any previous recovery codes are invalid. Save this list before signing in again; wait for the next Authenticator code if you just confirmed a device.
twoFactor.codesSaved: I have saved my recovery codes
twoFactor.noRecoveryCodes: You have no unused recovery codes. Generate a set with Authenticator, or change device using a code from your phone or your recent recovery sign-in.
twoFactor.continueReplacement: Verify and set up new device
twoFactor.replacementHelp: Enter a code from the old device or an unused recovery code. For 5 minutes after recovery sign-in, you can also use the code you just signed in with to start device replacement, even if it was your last code. 2FA stays enabled throughout.
twoFactor.replacementScanHelp: Scan the new QR with your new device and confirm its code. The old device stays active until confirmation; then its codes stop working.
twoFactor.regenerateHelp: Verify with an Authenticator code or an unused recovery code. This replaces every previous recovery code and requires signing in again.
twoFactor.title: Google Authenticator
twoFactor.loginHelp: Enter your Google Authenticator code, or select recovery code if your phone is unavailable. This sign-in request expires after 5 minutes.
twoFactor.failed: Unable to complete Authenticator verification. Please try again.
twoFactor.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
